library.title: Your Library
library.empty_desc: Run a scan to discover games across Epic, GOG, Ubisoft Connect, EA App, Itch.io, and any custom .exe. Steam games sync via the API in Settings.

batch.steam_restarted: Steam restarted to apply new shortcuts

sources.title: Sources
sources.subtitle: Tokoru scans these locations for games. {{total}} games detected across {{active}} active sources.

language.title: Language
language.desc: Choose the interface language. Also propagates to Steam Store and GOG metadata fetches.
language.refresh_started: Language changed — refreshing game descriptions in the background.

general.default_action_desc: What happens when you click a library item.
general.replay_onboarding_desc: Re-run the welcome wizard. Your library and connected accounts stay intact.

steam.user_profile_desc: Select the account to receive shortcuts.
steam.restart_after_push_desc: Required for new shortcuts to appear immediately in the library without manual restart.
steam.backup_vdf_desc: Last backup: 4 minutes ago. Keeping 12 historical versions.
steam.collections_grouping_desc: How Tokoru bundles your games into Steam sidebar Collections. Applies to native Steam games AND the shortcuts Tokoru pushes. Changing this rebuilds Collections immediately — make sure Steam is closed.
steam.rebuild_desc: Recreates the sidebar Collections from the current library + selected grouping mode. Steam must be closed — it holds the file open otherwise.
steam.rebuild_needs_metadata: Run "Fetch metadata" first — {{pending}} of {{total}} Steam games still need their franchise / tags / developer data for the Franchise grouping algorithm to do its job.
steam.fetch_metadata_desc: Multi-source sync (Steam Store + SteamSpy + IGDB + HowLongToBeat + Wikidata) — drives the 'By franchise' grouping above. Rows synced within 14 days are skipped unless you force refresh.

background.run_bg_desc: Allows accurate playtime tracking without the app being active.
background.polling_desc: Lower = more accurate tracking. Higher = lower CPU usage.
background.sync_to_steam_desc: Writes to localconfig.vdf so Steam correctly displays hours for non-Steam shortcuts. Last sync: {{date}}.
background.sync_now_desc: Steam must be closed — Valve overwrites localconfig.vdf on shutdown.
background.ignore_launchers_desc: Prevents padding playtime when only the launcher is open.

downloads.default_dir_desc: Used for any source without a per-source override. Each game gets its own subfolder.
downloads.per_source_desc: Send Epic / GOG / EA / Ubi / Itch / Custom downloads to a different drive. Leave blank to inherit the default.
downloads.max_parallel_desc: Higher = faster overall, lower = better for slow connections.
downloads.concurrency_desc: How many games can install in parallel. Above 3 the Steam-side bandwidth limit kicks in.
downloads.auto_push: Auto-push to Steam after download finishes
downloads.auto_push_desc: Each completed download is immediately added to your Steam shortcuts.
downloads.helper_bins_desc: Tokoru uses legendary (Epic) and gogdl (GOG) under the hood. Downloaded once on first use and stored in app-data.
downloads.cli_bins_desc: Tokoru bundles legendary (Epic) and gogdl (GOG) so installs don't require an external launcher. Re-download when an update is published.
downloads.detect_installs_desc: Re-scan legendary's installed.json + your configured GOG download dirs and back-fill install paths. Runs automatically after Epic/GOG library sync — use this for catch-up when you installed through the launcher directly.

playtime.detect_installs_desc: Re-scan legendary's installed.json + your configured GOG download dirs and back-fill install paths. Runs automatically after Epic/GOG library sync — use this for catch-up when you installed through the launcher directly.

appearance.accent_desc: The brand color used across buttons, links, and the focus ring.
appearance.reduce_motion_desc: Skip enter/scale animations across the app. Mirrors the OS-level accessibility preference.
appearance.density_desc: Spacing of the game grid. Compact fits more, spacious shows bigger covers.

steamgriddb.api_key_blank_hint: Leave blank to use the bundled default key.
steamgriddb.preferred_style_desc: Applies to new artwork fetches. Existing covers stay as-is unless you re-fetch them from the game details panel.
steamgriddb.auto_fetch_desc: Backfills missing cover/hero/logo on every scan + replaces low-res GOG/Epic native artwork with HD SteamGridDB picks.
steamgriddb.prefer_animated_desc: When SteamGridDB has both, pick the .webm over the static image. Looks great but each animated grid adds load on the Steam library scroll — keep under ~10 animated picks total to avoid Steam-side lag. Toggling this re-fetches matching covers in your library (upgrade to animated when ON, downgrade to static when OFF) — the static fallback for Steam games comes from your local Steam cache so it's zero-download.
steamgriddb.allow_nsfw_desc: Off by default — NSFW-tagged grids are filtered out of the auto backfill. The Browse covers panel still shows them with its own NSFW toggle.
steamgriddb.refetch_now_desc: Re-run the backfill against the whole library with the current SteamGridDB preferences (style / animated / NSFW). Use this after flipping a toggle to apply it to your existing covers.

startup.open_at_login_desc: Auto-launches Tokoru when you sign in to Windows.
startup.start_minimized_desc: Skip the splash and run silently in the system tray on boot.
startup.auto_update_status: Currently on v{{version}} — up to date
startup.restart_steam_desc: Kills the Steam process and re-launches it. Use after manual edits to userdata files.

about.tagline: Made for PC gamers by a PC gamer.
about.credits: Artwork via SteamGridDB. Inter font by Rasmus Andersson.
about.open_appdata_desc: Where the local SQLite DB and settings live.

source_tile.no_scan_yet: No scan recorded yet — run a rescan to detect installed games.

footer.unsupported_question: Looking for a launcher we don't support?

downloads_page.title: Downloads
downloads_page.nothing_desc: Owned Epic and GOG games show an Install button on hover. Start one from the Library — pause, resume, and retry land here.

stats_page.title: Stats
stats_page.subtitle: Your real playtime across every launcher — including the hours Steam doesn't see.
stats_page.no_tracked: No tracked playtime yet — leave Tokoru running and play a game to see this populate.
stats_page.no_session_data: No session data in this range yet.
stats_page.untouched_title: Haven't been touched in a while

onboarding.hero_title: Bring your whole library to Steam.
onboarding.hero_desc: We'll detect your games across Epic, GOG, Ubisoft Connect, EA App, Itch.io, and any custom .exe — then push them into Steam as proper shortcuts with real artwork.
onboarding.connect_steam_desc: Sign in once with your Steam account to import your owned library (no API key required). You can skip this and connect later from Settings.
onboarding.steam_window_hint: A Steam sign-in window has opened. Complete the login there, then come back here.
onboarding.connect_epic_desc: Sign in once to pull your owned Epic Games library (no API key, no manual input).
onboarding.connect_gog_desc: Sign in once to pull your owned GOG library (no API key, no manual input).
onboarding.consent_track_desc: More accurate than Steam for games launched from other clients.
onboarding.consent_sync_desc: So Steam shows the real hours under each game.
onboarding.privacy_note: Nothing is uploaded. Everything stays on this PC.
onboarding.welcome_desc: Let's set up your unified game library in a few steps.
onboarding.step_steam_desc: Sign in to Steam to import your library and push shortcuts.
onboarding.step_launchers_desc: We'll detect installed games from Epic, GOG, Ubisoft Connect, EA App, Itch.io.
onboarding.step_done_desc: Your library is ready. You can run more scans from the Sources page any time.
